# Habr.com

> > Habr is a Russian-language IT community platform offering technical articles, news, and professional networking for developers and tech enthusiasts.

The site provides account management services, promotional offers for Habr community members, and serves as a hub for technology professionals in Russian-speaking markets. Note: The provided data appears to contain unrelated cruise and TV guide content that may be classification errors.
